children: Indaptus Therapeutics entered into a Stock Purchase Agreement for a private placement of 20,338,974 common shares, expected to generate approximately $24.0 million in gross proceeds. Shares are priced at the Nasdaq Minimum Price plus $0.015 per share. Closing is subject to customary conditions, with the company committing to file a resale registration statement after closing. Proceeds will support working capital, R&D, and early-stage evaluation of a neurotechnology device for sleep-related conditions.
: Stock Purchase Agreement for private placement of common stock
: Fund working capital and R&D, including sleep-device preclinical work
